plan.title: District Health Overview
plan.subtitle: Key health indicators across districts

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM district_health_factsheet

panels.title: Average vaccination rate
panels.sql: SELECT State, AVG({{p1.Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)}}) AS avg_vaccination FROM district_health_factsheet GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly trend of stunting
panels.sql: SELECT Survey Round, AVG({{p1.Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)}}) AS avg_stunting FROM district_health_factsheet GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 districts by improved sanitation
panels.sql: SELECT District, AVG({{p1.Households with improved sanitation facility (%)}}) AS avg_sanitation FROM district_health_factsheet GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This page provides an overview of key health indicators across different districts. The data is aggregated at the state level for vaccination rates. The trend of stunting is shown over time. The table displays the top 10 districts based on the average percentage of households with improved sanitation facilities. All values are placeholders and represent aggregated data.
